name: mize-coworker
description: Claude as a small coworker in the terminal: an orange pixel-art Claude, two rows tall, in 132 frames. While a turn runs he sits beside the spinner in a scene for every spinner word (a thought bubble, a pen on a notepad, a book, a magnifying glass over text or over a globe, a laptop, a terminal, his own small helpers, a gear, a scroll for a skill, a plug for an MCP call); idle on the status row he breathes, blinks, strolls, yawns and sips a coffee, sweats near a full context and sleeps frosted once the prompt cache goes cold. While the main session rests and agents or workflows work in the background he minds them with a skit every few seconds: a rocket as they start, a paddle with how many are at work, a radar, a headset, a helper bringing a finished agent's report, juggling, bubble gum, popcorn, a paper plane, a plant that grows with the wait. The spinner word says what is happening (Reading register.ts, Running npm), and /coworker demo plays every animation once. Draws only; nothing reaches the model.

sprite.title: Show Claude beside the prompt footer
sprite.description: When on, Claude (8 cells by 2 rows; 4 by 1 with big off) and a short dim caption (reading, running, needs you) sit after the mode labels at the right of the prompt footer in interactive terminal sessions, and Claude wanders a few cells of that row while idle.

picture.title: Draw Claude as an orange picture
picture.description: When on, Claude is drawn as orange pixel art (the terminal's Image element; a terminal without kitty graphics shows his braille outline, dim, instead). When off, he is orange braille text.

big.title: Draw Claude two rows tall
big.description: When on (and the picture is on), Claude's picture is 8 cells by 2 rows: it spans the status row and the short mode row under it, and beside the spinner the blank row above the spinner line and the line. Off: 4 cells by 1 row, as in 0.2.0, for a terminal where the two-row picture does not sit well. The braille drawing is one row either way.

besideSpinner.title: Claude beside the spinner while a turn runs
besideSpinner.description: When on (and the picture is on), Claude moves up beside the main loop's spinner while its turn runs, left of the spinner line, and back to the footer when it ends.

scenes.title: Scenes beside the spinner
scenes.description: When on (with the picture and big on), Claude beside the spinner is a scene 12 cells by 2 rows: himself and a prop for what the session is doing, one for every spinner word (a thought bubble, a pen on a notepad, a book, a magnifying glass over text or over a globe, a laptop, a terminal, a globe, one to three small helpers, a speech bubble, a gear, a scroll, a plug). Off: his solo frame there too, 8 by 2. The footer always draws the solo frame.

narrate.title: Say what is happening on the spinner
narrate.description: When on, the main loop's spinner word becomes what the session is doing (Reading statusline.sh, Running npm, Browsing example.com) instead of a random verb. File names are basenames, commands are the program name only, never arguments.

animate.title: Animate Claude
animate.description: When off (reduced motion), Claude shows the first frame of each activity and no animation timer runs (no breath, blink, wander or sleep loop); it still changes with the activity and falls asleep after 10 idle minutes.

gestures.title: Small gestures
gestures.description: When on, Claude waves when a session opens, hops when a turn ends with an answer (cheers after one of two minutes or more), flinches when one of the main loop's own tool calls fails (at most once every 10 seconds), while idle strolls, looks around, hops, yawns or sips a coffee every 12 to 30 seconds, sweating near a full context, eyeing an hourglass when a usage window runs hot and glancing at a small terminal while a shell runs in the background, and while he minds background agents plays a skit every 4 to 10 seconds. Off, he only breathes and blinks there.

seasonal.title: Seasonal and time-of-day moves
seasonal.description: When on (with gestures), an idle Claude sometimes sits by a glowing jack-o'-lantern from 24 to 31 October, and a Claude minding background agents holds a lantern from 22:00 to 06:00 (the night shift) and eats a sandwich from 12:00 to 13:00, all in local time.
